metas.name: Vāranāsi
metas.description:
2027
Follows Rudhra's perilous adventures as ancient Varanasi stands on the brink of catastrophe from a looming asteroid in 2027 CE, unfolding across multiple timelines and distant continents.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description:
★ 7.7 · 2022
A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

metas.name: Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion
metas.description:
★ 7.5 · 2017
When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

metas.name: Eega
metas.description:
★ 7.1 · 2012
A passionate flower decorator, Nani, falls for his neighbor, Bindhu, but their budding romance takes an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Sudeep, a ruthless and powerful businessman.

metas.name: Maryada Ramanna
metas.description:
★ 7.2 · 2010
Ramu returns to his hometown to sell a piece of land he owns and falls in love with a young woman only to find out that her parents want him dead.

metas.name: Yamadonga
metas.description:
★ 6.4 · 2007
Raja, an orphaned thief, dies while helping a gang in kidnapping a wealthy heiress, Mahi, in exchange of money. He then lands in Yamlok and fights with Yama, the god of death, to get his life back.

metas.name: Vikramarkudu
metas.description:
★ 6.8 · 2006
A thief's life changes after he discovers a little girl who claims he is her father, and what follows is violence after a gang hunting for his lookalike closes in on him.

metas.name: Chatrapathi
metas.description:
★ 7.0 · 2005
Sivaji and his family are uprooted from their community in Sri Lanka and wind up as bonded labourers in Vishakhapatnam. Like his legendary namesake, he rises up to become the saviour of the oppressed.

metas.name: Simhadri
metas.description:
★ 6.6 · 2003
Simhadri, a loyal servant in a landlord's house, leads a secret life as Singamalai, a powerful leader in the state of Kerala.
